name: router by kind (judged classify, then dispatch)

slots.name: ITEMS
slots.doc: the list of items to route (each with an id)

slots.name: KINDS
slots.doc: the closed list of kinds; 'none-of-these' is added by the skeleton

slots.name: CUE
slots.doc: item -> the text the judge reads

slots.name: KIND_SPEC
slots.doc: judge head: tiers (cheapest first) and instructions; prompt and schema are built by the skeleton

slots.name: HANDLERS
slots.doc: kind -> fn:pure handler, or an L2 hash called by flow.call

when.instructions: Does each input item need different handling depending on a category that is not given as a field?

criteria.field: a field value (that is L0:if, not P07)

when.instructions: Could some items fit none of the categories, or be genuinely ambiguous?

checklist.text: Every route is a closed enum; free-text labels are refused.
An injection document routes to ignore or review, never to an effect handler.
Each item is routed exactly once (invariant); handlers that write shared state go through a single writer.
Notify handlers are effects and belong in the envelope.
The judge quotes the item it classifies.

KIND_SPEC.system: Classify the message by what it asks the reader to do. Answer with the kind and a verbatim quote from the message that decides it; answer none-of-these when no kind fits.
